[[Lake Valor]] }} '''Bogging Down Quagsire''' (Japanese: '''VS ヌオー''' ''VS Quagsire''), titled '''VS Quagsire''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 400th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 63rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Downpour and Helping Hand''' (Japanese: '''大雨と助け手''' ''Heavy Rain and Helpers'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Storms and Helpers''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} After escaping from [[Team Galactic]] at [[Lake Verity]], [[Roseanne]] and {{adv|Sebastian}} hurry with [[Johanna]] to her house in [[Twinleaf Town]]. Finding a pair of shoes on the floor, Johanna realizes that {{adv|Diamond}} took the new outfit she bought for him to the lake. She reveals that she had placed a cell phone inside of the new jacket, then takes out her own phone to call it. To her relief, Diamond answers. Diamond apologizes to Johanna for putting her in danger, then reassures her that he is okay and {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit}} is with him. When he tells her that he will be unable to return home for some time, a sound blares through the speaker on Johanna's phone. She asks Diamond where he is, and he reveals that he is inside of Team Galactic's aircraft. {{adv|Platinum}} brings [[Candice]] and [[Maylene]] to safety in an [[Snowpoint Temple|ancient building]] after they are caught in a blizzard. As her {{TP|Platinum|Rapidash}} uses its flames to warm the unconscious [[Gym Leader]]s, Platinum regrets being unable to protect {{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Uxie}}. Suddenly, a loud roar booms from somewhere inside. Suspecting the sound is coming from a [[wild Pokémon]], Platinum weakly grabs a [[Poké Ball]] and prepares to catch it. The freezing temperature quickly wears her down, and she collapses. As the Poké Ball rolls away, a large, shadowed {{p|Regigigas|figure}} approaches it. At the dried-up [[Lake Valor]], [[Rad Rickshaw]] desperately tries to awaken {{adv|Pearl}}. Panicking, he can't decide whether to chase after Team Galactic's aircraft or help Pearl. Behind Rad, a hooded person appears and declares that the best thing to do is use {{m|Rain Dance}}. Rain pours down from the sky, and the {{p|Magikarp}} that were helplessly flopping on the ground are overjoyed. Rad is delighted that the lake is filling with water, and the hooded person reveals himself to be [[Crasher Wake]]. Crasher Wake explains that [[Byron]] had warned him about Team Galactic's plan, but was too late. As he picks up Pearl from the ground, Crasher Wake admires his effort against Team Galactic, and is reminded of a [[Palmer|certain someone]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}} infiltrates the Galactic airship that is holding {{adv|Lake guardians|Mesprit}}. * {{adv|Platinum}}, [[Candice]], and [[Maylene]] are left stranded in the freezing cold. * [[Crasher Wake]] arrives and saves the dying {{p|Magikarp}} with {{m|Rain Dance}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Regigigas}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Maylene]] * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Candice]] * [[Jupiter]] (flashback) * [[Johanna]] * [[Rad Rickshaw]] * {{adv|Sebastian}} * [[Roseanne]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Shieldon}} ([[Don]]; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Rapidash}} ({{OP|Platinum|Rapidash}}) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}) * {{p|Lopunny}} ({{OP|Platinum|Lopunny}}) * {{p|Sableye}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Gastrodon}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; {{form|Gastrodon|West Sea}}; flashback) * {{p|Tangrowth}} ([[Jupiter]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Floatzel}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s) * {{p|Glameow}} ({{OP|Johanna|Glameow}}) * {{p|Clefairy}} (Cliff and Cliffette/{{tt|Pippirin and Pippiran|Chuang Yi}}; [[Rad Rickshaw]]'s) * {{p|Dunsparce}} ([[Roseanne]]'s) * {{p|Mesprit}} ({{DL|Lake guardians (Adventures)|Mesprit|Adventures}}) * {{p|Regigigas}} ({{DL|Reg|Adventures}}; silhouette; debut) * {{p|Magikarp}} (multiple) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 沼王|VS Quagsire}} |fr=L'averse salvatrice |de=VS.
